package.name: combat_robot_msgs
package.description: SAN combatrobot_1 swarm message definitions (SAN-IDS-CMD-001 v1.3). Provides LTERoleAnnouncement (§5.14), RobotStatus with v1.3 lte_active / is_lte_backup_designated + PHASE 7 command_id echo fields, VideoStreamRequest (§3.9) / VideoStreamHandle (§4.5), and the v1.3 PHASE 7 SwarmRobotCommand variants (FormationCommand, MissionStateCommand, FireAuthorization, JammingCommand, WaypointCommand, ManualOverrideCommand, EmergencyStop) plus the Hub-level SwarmHealthSummary rollup. v1.4 PHASE 8: Hub-Deputy redundancy + 4-tier Leader succession via LeaderRoleAnnouncement (§5.15) and HubRoleAnnouncement (§5.16).
